items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: It was in somebody's band. ... Yeah, I knew Spencer very well. He was with the Blue Rhythm Band. And I knew him before he was with the Blue Rhythm Band.

ctx.x: And I'd like to ask you about O'Neil Spencer, too.

Oh, that's my boy. O'Neil Spencer. I don't know when and how I met him, or where. It was in somebody's band. I don't know if it was... I don't know how you can work with people and don't know when was the first time you saw them or anything. Yeah, I knew Spencer very well. He was with the Blue Rhythm Band. And I knew him before he was with the Blue Rhythm Band. One of them things.
What kind of a person was O'Neil Spencer?
